For Petitioner: Mr. R.Rameshraja  For Respondents: Mr.P.Sathish, AGP for R1 to  Mr.Su.Srinivasan for R4  ORDER

In respect of an award issued by the second respondent in October 2023, the petitioner initiated proceedings before the first respondent under Section 3-G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 (Highways Act).
According to the petitioner, the second respondent did not determine the value of three tamarind trees and a PVC pipeline.
The petitioner also asserts that the first respondent had orally directed the second respondent to issue a supplementary award in respect thereof.
Because such action was not taken, the present writ petition has been lodged.
2. Mr.P.Sathish, learned Additional Government Pleader, accepts notice for respondents 1 to 3.
Mr.Su.Srinivasan, learned standing counsel, accepts notice for the fourth respondent.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 07/01/2026 08:35:46 pm )

3. Learned Additional Government Pleader submits that the first respondent may be directed to consider the petitioner's request for enhanced compensation, including in respect of the tamarind trees and PVC pipeline, and to pass orders thereon.

The Highways Act makes the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, applicable in respect of such proceedings.

5. Therefore, this writ petition is disposed of by directing the first respondent to consider the petitioner's grievance and issue an arbitral award in compliance with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
There will be no order as to costs.
